name: claude-sessions-streamdeck
description: Stream Deck plugin that shows the state of Claude desktop sessions and opens them on key press
author: Alex Wiegenstein

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/plugin.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --sourcemap --outfile=com.alexwiegenstein.claude-sessions.sdPlugin/bin/plugin.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && echo '{ "type": "module" }' > com.alexwiegenstein.claude-sessions.sdPlugin/bin/package.json
scripts.watch: esbuild src/plugin.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --sourcemap --outfile=com.alexwiegenstein.claude-sessions.sdPlugin/bin/plugin.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --watch
scripts.pack: npm run build && streamdeck pack com.alexwiegenstein.claude-sessions.sdPlugin --output dist --force
